Provenance
==========

The 12 `.toml` files in this directory are vendored VERBATIM (byte-for-byte,
no reformatting) from:

    https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty-theme

  Commit:  03cce642656759f440c97bb99ce65fc1c5b064a1
  Fetched: 2026-08-19
  License: Apache License 2.0 (see ../LICENSE-alacritty-theme.txt, copied
           verbatim from the same repository's LICENSE file)

Each file keeps its original upstream filename and content unmodified. They
were chosen to span the Alacritty theme schema's variety rather than to
represent any particular popularity ranking:

  dracula.toml           - classic shape: primary/normal/bright only, comments
  monokai.toml            - minimal: primary/normal/bright only, no comments,
                             no cursor/selection/dim/etc. (floor case)
  alacritty_0_12.toml     - dim, hints, search (no cursor/selection sections
                             at all - tests optional-section omission)
  konsole_linux.toml      - dim, bright_foreground, search using the
                             CellForeground/CellBackground sentinel strings
                             (not hex) in colors.search.focused_match
  github_dark.toml        - indexed_colors ([[colors.indexed_colors]] array)
  catppuccin_mocha.toml   - "kitchen sink": dim, dim_foreground,
                             bright_foreground, vi_mode_cursor, search,
                             footer_bar, hints, selection, inline comments
  catppuccin_latte.toml   - same kitchen-sink shape as mocha, light palette
  rose_pine.toml          - vi_mode_cursor, hints (foreground/background
                             table form), no comments
  gruvbox_dark.toml       - comments (incl. a commented-out alternate value)
  nord.toml                - plain dark theme, comments, no optional sections
  solarized_light.toml    - plain light theme, comments, no optional sections
  one_dark.toml            - plain dark theme, comments, no optional sections

None of the fetched upstream files use the legacy `0x`-prefixed color form
(Alacritty deprecated it in favor of `#rrggbb`; a scan of ~50 files from the
same repo turned up zero uses). `0x` parsing is covered instead by an inline
synthetic TOML string in
`crates/termlab_core/src/color_scheme.rs` (see the
`deserialize_0x_prefixed_color_form` test) rather than by a vendored fixture,
since it would not be an honest "verbatim real file" otherwise.

`tests/fixtures/broken/not_a_valid_theme.toml` is NOT from upstream. It is a
hand-written, deliberately-malformed file used only to assert that a broken
theme file fails to parse without panicking. Do not treat it as vendored
Alacritty content.
